title: thelypteris alata var. subpinnata
intro: Thelypteris alata var. subpinnata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved alata fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Philippines, where it is believed to have several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote the expulsion of mucus. Bioactive constituents of T. alata var. subpinnata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
